title: Account sign-in and recovery
story: Sign-up, sign-in with a server session, and a password-reset request.

durability.basis: transcribed from the pilot archetype and hand-reviewed; test/spec.test.mjs keeps the two in step

state.lifetime: per process, in a file named on the command line - not a durable store

tables.name: records
tables.purpose: the value a write stores, read back by the reference the server issued

tables.name: sessions
tables.purpose: who the server decided the requester is, for this session only

tables.name: accounts
tables.purpose: the account a sign-up creates and sign-in reads

persistence.reference: session id issued by the server as a cookie
persistence.reload_assertion: reloading /account still shows the display name the sign-up stored, because the session cookie identifies the account

routes.effect: create the account, start a session, and redirect to the account page
read the session and show the display name it identifies
start a password reset and redirect to a reference-addressed page
read the reset by reference and render it

validation.on_missing: the server refuses the submission and re-renders the form; no account is created
validation.on_success: create the account, issue a session, and answer 303 with Location: /account

acceptance: the echoed display name is held by the session the server issued, so it survives a reload only if the session does
the session cookie carries HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Path=/ (and Secure when the arm sets it)
an empty submit is observed to be refused
